invariants.rationale: The method returns an Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> via either handleInsert or handleUpdate, which should not return null.
The partition integer is used to get bucket info and log errors, and NPE is not explicitly handled, so it must not be null at this point.
partitioner is cast and used to obtain bucket info; null would throw immediately on cast.
instantTime is used in constructing the returned WriteStatus and/or logging; it being null may cause errors.
recordItr is passed to handleInsert/handleUpdate, and expected to yield a non-null Iterator.
